title: Love Language #5: Physical Touch
coreMove: Touch speaks love only when it is welcomed, timed well, and matched to the spouse's dialect, from brief contact to crisis comfort.

exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use infant touch research to show touch as a basic love signal.
Show holding a crying spouse as comfort before advice.

exampleSpecs.audience: spouses learning public and private dialects
exampleSpecs.stakes: one form of touch mistaken for all forms
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Contrast public embrace with holding hands and back rubs.
Make welcomed timing the test for appropriate loving touch.

exampleSpecs.audience: spouses who confuse desire with primary language
exampleSpecs.stakes: sexual interest used as the whole diagnosis
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Separate high sex drive from the primary emotional language.

exampleSpecs.stakes: intent used to override received meaning
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Repair a wrong public-touch dialect by learning the welcomed one.
